owner: The driver owns the sensor. The observation plugin owns subscription health. Registering a subscription does not grant motion control.
inputs: Installed ROS message type and topic, sensor id, TTL, sample timestamps and frame when available.
outputs: waiting, online, stale, error or removed state, bounded message preview, source topic and timing.
acceptance: Inject timestamped samples, stop the source, resume it, unload the definition. Verify transition evidence and unrelated sensor continuity.
rollback: Remove the observation definition to unsubscribe. Restore its previous version to observe it again.
